resources.string: Research prototype. It is not a medical device and must not be used to diagnose or rule out autism.

The test shows the 300 pictures of the Saliency4ASD dataset (Duan et al., 2019). They are not bundled with the app because the photos belong to their authors (MIT1003 collection).

1. Download TrainingDataset.rar from Zenodo record 2647418.
2. Extract it and copy the TrainingData/Images folder to this phone (or extract it here with an archive app).
3. Tap Choose folder and select that Images folder.

The app checks every file against its known checksum and keeps a private copy.

Verified: %1$d of 300
Missing: %2$d
Rejected (checksum mismatch): %3$d

Pick the TrainingData/Images folder of the original Saliency4ASD archive.
